effect_description_eng:
[When Digivolving] You may play 1 level 3 purple Digimon card from your trash without paying its memory cost.
[End of Attack] [Once Per Turn] You may digivolve 1 of your other Digimon in play into a Digimon card with the [Undead] or [Dark Animal] trait from your trash without paying its memory cost.
